mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 80 degrees outside Verona City Hall under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The Public Works Department is hard at work maintaining our city streets and utilities. You can keep up with their latest efforts and other city news by subscribing to the official City of Verona digital newsletter.
We have plenty to do this week. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today, and tomorrow you can catch trivia at either Hop Haus Brewing or Lake Lou-ee.
During the early hours of July 28, an officer patrolling Fireman Park discovered an occupied vehicle after hours, resulting in an arrest on an active warrant.
Treat yourself to the Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor of the day at Culver's, which is open until 10 PM tonight.
